posts.title: Note III: A sitemap you can walk through
posts.description: Back when I started this blog, I was wandering around Octothorpes 1 and ended up on the pages of a few artists who make ANSI art. Not long after, someone on a forum was talking about sitemaps, and that gave me the idea: draw the map of this site in ANSI. So I made one . posts.title: Neat Finds #07: Firehose Toys, Fediverse Games and Small Machines
posts.description: Issue seven leans on the social web, but not in the usual way. The first half is people playing with the Bluesky firehose and the fediverse as if they were toys: rain, screensavers, arcade games, chess by toot and a book club living in the margins of an e-reader.
